en: Black‑and‑white street view of a European city with a cobblestone road curving past a large, ornate stone building in late 19th‑ / early 20th‑century style. The building has steep gabled roofs, dormers, bay windows, and a corner balcony. People in early 1900s clothing walk along the street, and a child or vendor stands in the middle carrying a basket. The image has the handwritten numbers "4515" at the top and "414" at the bottom right, but no other visible text or caption.
